summary: Iteration 4 backend: 21/23 pass (one test was my incorrect assumption — see notes; one is a REAL backend bug). Two CRITICAL gaps: (1) Backend POST /api/trades/apply does NOT support custom strategies — only iterates built-in STRATEGIES list and ignores payload.username, returns 404 'Strategy not found' for any custom_* id. (2) Frontend app/(tabs)/chain.tsx has NO WebSocket implementation at all — still uses 15-second setInterval polling on line 38, and the LIVE/POLLING badge is completely absent from the rendered header (styles for liveBadge/liveDot/liveText are defined but never used). Custom-strategy CRUD, validation (400s), WS endpoint at /api/ws/chain/{symbol}, Greeks/Payoff with username resolution, and all iter1/2/3 regression endpoints pass. Editor screen source code looks correct (legs 1-6, BUY/SELL & CE/PE/FUT toggles, preview creates temp + cleans up, save → /(tabs)/strategies). Strategies tab source has +New button, CUSTOM badge, and passes username to greeks/payoff.

critical.issue: Does not resolve custom strategies. apply_strategy() at server.py line 535 only does `next((s for s in STRATEGIES if s.id == payload.strategy_id), None)` — never checks db.custom_strategies. Passing a custom_xxxxxxxxxx id returns 404 'Strategy not found'. Fix: replace that lookup with `strategy = await find_strategy(payload.strategy_id, payload.username)` (helper already exists at line 1638). Also persist `strategy_name` correctly (use strategy['name']).

minor.issue: find_strategy() with username=None queries `db.custom_strategies.find_one({'id': strategy_id})` WITHOUT username filter, so anyone who knows a custom_xxxxxxxxxx id can fetch greeks/payoff for another user's strategy. Minor info leak. Consider requiring username when strategy_id startswith 'custom_'.

ui_bugs.issue: Iter 4 WebSocket feature is NOT IMPLEMENTED. File still imports only from '../../src/api' (no WS code), uses `setInterval(load, 15000)` on line 38, never opens ws://.../api/ws/chain/{symbol}. The header has no <View> rendering liveBadge/liveDot/liveText even though those styles are declared (lines 121-132) — dead CSS. Acceptance criteria 'Chain tab shows LIVE/POLLING badge' fails. Implementation required: useWebSocket hook that connects to `${EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL.replace('https','wss')}/api/ws/chain/${symbol}`, handles onopen→set status 'LIVE', onerror/onclose→fall back to setInterval polling and set status 'POLLING', render badge in header.

integration_issues.flow: Apply custom strategy from Strategies tab
integration_issues.issue: Even though strategies.tsx renders custom strategies and 'Place Paper Trade' calls api.applyStrategy(u, selected.id, ...), the backend will reject every custom strategy id with 404 because of the apply_strategy bug above. End-to-end flow is broken.

action_items: Backend FIX (CRITICAL): in server.py apply_strategy (line ~535), replace `strategy = next((s for s in STRATEGIES ...), None)` with `strategy = await find_strategy(payload.strategy_id, payload.username)`. This unblocks the entire Custom Strategy feature.

Frontend FIX (CRITICAL): implement WebSocket consumer in app/(tabs)/chain.tsx — connect to wss://.../api/ws/chain/{symbol}, parse {type:'chain', data:...} messages, update chain state, render <View testID='chain-live-badge'> in header with green dot+LIVE on success, gray dot+POLLING on failure/fallback. Keep polling as fallback only.
(Minor) tighten find_strategy: require username when id starts with 'custom_' to avoid cross-user data access.

Re-run /app/backend/tests/test_iteration4.py after fixes; expect 22/23 pass (the test_greeks_custom_without_username_404 assertion is a security-tightening item, not strictly required by the iter4 spec).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~1740 lines — strongly recommend splitting into routers (custom_strategies, ws, payments, market, trades, broker, notifications).
WebSocket endpoint correctly handles invalid symbol (close 4404) and disconnect; loops every 2s as spec'd — verified by direct connection.
chain.tsx has unused liveBadge/liveDot/liveText styles indicating partial work — looks like the feature was started server-side but never wired into the React Native component.
Editor.tsx — refreshPreview creates a temp custom strategy then deletes it; works but is wasteful. A dedicated POST /api/payoff/preview that accepts inline legs (no DB write) would be cleaner.
apply_strategy stores strategy_name from STRATEGIES match — even after fix, ensure strategy.get('name') is read from the resolved (possibly custom) dict, not from a hard-coded built-in.

rca_of_issue: RCA #1 (apply_strategy): when iter4 was added, find_strategy() helper and CreateCustomIn model were added (lines 1622-1698) and Greeks/Payoff endpoints were updated to call await find_strategy(...). However the older apply_strategy endpoint at line 535 was NOT migrated — it still uses the inline `next(... in STRATEGIES)` lookup written in iter1. ApplyStrategyIn HAS username field already, so backend fix is one line. RCA #2 (chain WS): the backend WS route exists and works (verified by `websockets.connect` returning 2 valid chain messages within 5s and INVALID symbol closing with 4404). The frontend chain.tsx file was never edited for iter4 — only styles (liveBadge etc) were added but no WebSocket logic, no badge rendering, no fallback handler. Reproduction: open /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/chain.tsx — search 'WebSocket' or 'ws://' → zero matches; search 'POLLING' → zero matches in JSX.
